# Cargo metadata facts

Immutable synthetic format-1 documents and independently authored expected facts/errors. IDs are deliberately opaque. The complete example retains inactive declarations, mixed normal/dev/build edge kinds, nullable target predicates, feature lists and an external namesake. No Cargo/decoder output generates expected.json. Every refusal changes a documented shape/join of an otherwise complete input. Native executable assertions, projections and byte mutations remain in the module, not these fixtures.
